location: Bunbury (Blair Street), South West, WA, Australia

main_turf.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise (left-handed). Completely redeveloped into a world-class 1,968m championship track featuring cambered turns, a wide 348m home straight, and a brand new 1,700m straight chute. The modern layout eliminates tight-turn leader traps, providing a fair contest for all running styles.
main_turf.post_bias: Fair across all distances following redevelopment. Long straightaway chute runs for 1200m, 1400m, and 1700m races give wider draws ample time to find cover before cornering.

handicapping_angles.redeveloped_championship_layout: The upgraded 1,968m circuit and cambered turns prevent early speed bias. Stalkers ('P') and strong closing swoopers ('S') get every opportunity on Good ground.
handicapping_angles.perth_metro_shipper_class_edge: Bunbury is Western Australia's premier South West regional hub. Top Perth metropolitan yards (Adam Durrant, Neville Parnham, Grant & Alana Williams, Simon Miller) regularly ship runners down the Kwinana Freeway. Upgrade Perth metro drop-downs (+3.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.bunbury_cup_carnival: During the autumn Bunbury Cup ($150k+ Listed) & Bunbury Stakes feature meeting, race quality elevates to Listed/Group grade. Factor in higher speed par offsets for feature races.

par_adjustment.tier: Tier 2 (WA Premier Regional HQ / Bunbury Cup)
